title: Issue map: a search option, a repository option, and faded outside blockers
summary: issue_map.py takes --search <GitHub query> and --repo owner/name; a blocker the search leaves out is drawn faded and dashed, loads its own blockers with state, and is never shown ready while one is open; unknown arguments are refused; default run unchanged. Version 33.
friction: review-182 round 1 took about five hours of wall time (18.8M ms reported), most of it waiting; the cause was not visible to the orchestrator.
lessons_learned: An outside or partial node in a dependency graph must load its own blocker states, or it can look free while blocked.
deferred: issue map: an outside blocker that names a number which is not an issue shows ready, as on the full map, with no data problem listed. Severity low.
